targets.authors: Nelms, L.W., & Hutchins, E., Hutchins, D., & Pursley, R.
targets.title: Spirituality and the health of college students.
targets.evidence_quote:
The purpose of this study was
to partially replicate and extend the findings of Nelms et al. (2007) on the relationship between spirituality
and the health of university students.
targets.outcome_quote:
In keeping with the findings of Nelms et al. (2007), we found that
undergraduate students’ self-reported higher level of spirituality was positively related to student self-
reported level of physical health, emotional health, and exercise/sports.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All three retested spirituality-health relationships are explicitly described as agreeing with Nelms et al. Gender and race analyses extend the original and do not constitute failed replication components.

reasoning: An independent undergraduate sample tests the three published Nelms et al. associations. Other cited empirical works motivate the extension hypotheses or contextualize results and are not independently selected replication targets.
